fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) stock price rose 18.9% over three months and approaches 2.5% decline from year-to-date high, with 2026 fiscal year revenue growth rate of 14.8% accelerating for two consecutive years, justifying premium valuation versus S&P 500 median.
fields.summary_ko.1: FY2027 Q1 guidance anticipates low double-digit growth, with stock price volatility determinable at January 2027 results announcement timing, but average volatility following the past 7 earnings reports is limited (maximum 6.6% gain).
